notes.title: V1.05 Release! Rework hardcore mode magazine insert logic,Cheating prevent etc.
notes.notes:
Hi, fellews
又到了周更的时间！本次更新依旧根据玩家的反馈对游戏中的各种问题进行优化和调整。好了，废话不多说，以下是更新列表：

[h1][b]1. Rework hardcore mode magazine insert logic[/b][/h1]

Many players have complained more than once that the mag insertion in hardcore mode is very uncomfortable. Now, we have substantially revised the cartridge insertion in hard core mode. The judgment of the current magazine insertion is very loose, you can easily insert the magazine! This process will be very smooth.
We will continue to optimize the operation of the hard core mode next!

[h1][b]2. Duplicate weapon in multiplay prevent logic[/b][/h1]

After several versions of testing, we formally added a set of mechanisms to prevent the use of multiplayer network delays for weapon replication. We hope that this mechanism will allow everyone to enjoy reasonable game fun in multiplayer mode, and will not be affected by the cheating. This system is still under test, you are welcome to continue to give us more feedback.

[h1][b]3. Turret adjust[/b][/h1]

The initial health of the turret has been increased，6k/5k/7k/9k（Flame/Laser/MachineGun/Shotgun）。  
The cost of each repair is reduced to 500
After each wave is over, the turret will be automatically restored to full health!

[h3][b]4.Fixed bug where client players were not be harmed[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]5.Fixed the bug that the chainsaw does not unlock[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]6.Fixed a bug where players might not die after being thrown into the abyss in the fifth level[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]7.Fixed a bug that prevented double damage during bullet time[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]8.
Optimized the grenade model to reduce rendering costs. Even if there are a lot of grenade in the scene, the effect on the frame number is very low.[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]9.
Eliminate some variables that affect network consumption.[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]10.
Adjust the Spider Boss‘ health in Level 5. Now the gameplay is more reasonable.[/b][/h3]

Due to the preparation of our studio site to be relocated, next week's update will be postponed until the following week to merge and release! Stay tuned!


INTOGAMES

notes.title: Weekly update！V1.041 released，optimize and bug fix ！Rework the Shotgun reload ！
notes.notes:
Hi, fellows

This week's update continues to optimize and fix bugs. We completed the higher priority tasks as quickly as possible within a week.
Due to time constraints, if this update does not cover the update you are expecting, please understand.

Here is the update list:

[b]1.Rework the Shotgun reload in hardcore mode[/b]

First of all, thank you very much for your feedback. The reload logic of the original shotgun in hard core mode will be greatly affected by the frame rate. This leads to a wrong judgment of the shot when the shotgun is used to shoot under certain circumstances when the frame rate is changing violently. . After receiving a lot of complaints from players, we redesigned the reload logic of the shotgun in hard core mode. This new set of logic will work properly even if the frame rate is unstable.
We will continue to optimize the reload of other weapons in hardcore mode!

[b]2.Error correction in tutorial and text beautification[/b]

This is also a problem that many new players react to. We have fixed this problem, and beautified the fonts that appear in the teaching tips of the teaching concept, and also optimized the teaching interaction.
We will continue to optimize teaching tips for different types of VR devices.

[b]3.Snap turn/Smooth turn system Rework[/b]

This is also a problem that many new players react to. 
In this update, we reworked the system of snap turn and smooth turn. After this update, players will be able to customize the rotation angle and speed as well as the rotation method.
Here is the detail：

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29977407/b84cddc8e727b6b35095f0e220798639cf63f3f8.png[/img]

The content marked with a red frame in the picture is the content of this modification

[b]---Snap Turn switch---[/b]

When the Snap turn is [b]On[/b],
Each turn will rotate left or right at a fixed angle. The angle of rotation to the left or right depends on the value of "Turn Speed ​​/ Angle".
When this value is 90, your left or right turn will be 90 degrees, when this value is 45 , your left or right turn will be 45 degrees. 

When the Snap turn is [b]Off[/b],
Your turn will become smooth turn. The turning speed is depends on the value of "Turn Speed ​​/ Angle".
The larger the value, the faster the rotation speed.

[b]---Touch Locomotion/Turn---[/b]

The default is off. When this option is on, you can locomotion and rotation by touching the touchpad without pressing the touchpad.
We do not recommend turning on this option for devices with a joystick.

[b]4.Fix the Snipe penetrate bug[/b]
Thanks to “Ger-Todbringer” . 
His feedback made us notice this problem. Now this bug has been fixed.

[b]5.
Fixed a bug where the position of the gun did not respond when debugging the position of the gun in the "Gun Position" system settings[/b]

[b]6.
Optimized the  player's head and hands’ synchronize logic, which can greatly reduce the consumption of network transmission.[/b]

[b]7.
The detection range of the player's rear gun slot has been widened. It will be easier to take the sniper rifle from behind.[/b]

[b]8.
Improve the execution efficiency of player's hand detection logic.[/b]

[b]9.
Optimized the execution efficiency of logic in AI[/b]


We will continue to listen to players' opinions and feedback to optimize the official version. We expect to launch some non-maintenance updates after three or four minor maintenance updates. Everyone's opinions and feedback can leave a message under this topic, our development team will read your opinions carefully.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/681390/discussions/0/1480982338965696400/


INTOGAMES

notes.title: V1.03 Release！ Optimizations and fixes for V1.00！
notes.notes:
Dear fellows！
The first week after the official release is coming soon! We received a lot of feedback and suggestions during this period. Therefore, this weekly update  has made a lot of fixes and optimizations for the problems and feedback that occurred in the V1.00 version.

Here is the list：

1.
Added VR device selection interface
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29977407/1d971fbbe85078cf9b19a527c59b8301cbf45e2e.png[/img]
Now when you open the game, you will see a VR device selection interface. Please set it once according to your VR device. This is to better match the game with the VR device you are using. If your device has changed, please return to this setting interface to make changes.
This setting can solve the matching problem caused by frequent changes of the VR API of SteamVR or Oculus!

2.
Now the game window will be forced to front, so that the game window will not be disturbed by pop-up ads, etc.

3.
Optimized player initialization logic. Players now load faster.

4.
Fixed an issue where the HMD on the player screen would disappear when in multiplay.

5.
Optimized the rendering efficiency when using the sniper scope, reducing rendering cost.

6.
Optimized the player's gun slot initialization and the problem that gun slot positions are not synchronized in the online state.

7.
Optimized achievement trigger mechanism

8.
Optimized the feel of weapon pull bolts in hard core mode

9.
Fixed an issue where players transmitted ray jitters while online.

10.
Fixed a bug where the reward weapon MK18SD would not be unlocked on the level 2 of Hell difficulty.

11.
Fixed a bug where the flamethrower "Blue Flame" Perk could not learn

12.
Fixed an issue where the words "Please check your VR device!" Might continue to appear on the face.

13.
Fixed a bug where 30 Perk points should be returned on level 5 "Hard" difficulty.

14.
Fixed Tomahawk's physical collision

15.
Fixed a bug that could not pick up the dropped magazines in hard core mode (Now you can give your ammo to your teammate again ! )

16.Fixed the On/Off Hit Number Setting.

17.
Fixed a bug where players sometimes clicking Play or Exit in LobbyRoom would not work

18.
Fixed a bug where some monsters were still moving after death.

Enjoy！！

notes.title: Beta 1.42 released！Blood feast, Landmine, Auto two hand grab , Custom grab position！And talk about what's in the next version!
notes.notes:
Hi，Dear fellows

  We have received feedback since the popular Beta 1.4 release. Beta 1.42 then added the features and new features that players desperately need after the Beta 1.4 release!


Here is the update list：

[h1][b] 1.Update：  Two hand weapon system（Beta）--- Auto grab，custom grab position [/b][/h1]

a.Now the grab will be auto！You only needs to position hand close to the grip/guard position of the firearm, and the dual hold state will be triggered automatically. When you want to exit the dual hold, just move your hand away.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/4410870e322797281f0efdfc3f6e2dcbff6730e6.gif[/img]


b.If you want it manual，you can turn it off in the system settings. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/c4e11b87080489b662ea26f9d32c49cdee2bc23e.jpg[/img]


c.Now you can customize the grip position of the double hold! You can customize your position in the picture below! The blue point is the grip position.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/ff285c5c5e5aa2545d2e23c8fd6c172fa365eaff.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/fd29af8eeb821eff446e9636e46396f63cb5111e.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]2.Update： Bloodfeast (Alpha)[/b][/h1]

The zombie shooting game without bloodshed is unqualified! From this patch we will continue to improve and upgrade the violent performance in the game! In this version, when a monster is head exploding or exploding, the blood will splash into the environment and affect the environment.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/d07cadd8468a13ab0d2cb957d0f3c62e23446cc5.gif[/img]



[h1][b]3.New weapon： Landmine[/b][/h1]

  Now you can use the landmine to pre-empt the enemy! The low price and simple operation is simply a tool for brushing difference difficult level. 

Unlock it after complete Level 3 in Hard difficulty.

  Note that landmines can be hurt and can be detonated by attacking. At the same time, mines may also have the effect of a chain explosion if they are placed too tightly.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/04073944dae0882ffe68fe08bbd8c6f4a5d258f2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]4.Update： Shared Ammo，Shared Bloodbag[/b][/h1]
  In online games of 4 or more players, players often face the difficult situation of insufficient ammunition. Now,Shared ammunition or blood bags will appear in the game. These golden items will be picked up by one player and will be added to all players! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/80943eff08ce0341da21433a63916b9d1a92acf9.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]5.New feature： Friendly fire ranking[/b][/h1]
  Now a friendly fire ranking will appear after level complete.  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/6a5391119629a2f899e3e71199f24207e7dec314.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]6.Optimize：Bandwidth consumption of AI in multiplayer games[/b][/h1]


[h1][b]7.Bug Fixed：There was a very small chance that the client's profile will go wrong after a multiplay game. It will not happen now.  [/b][/h1]






--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1][b]So what'll be in the next version？:peace:[/b][/h1]

[h1] 1.New weapons	[/h1]
We used to collect the weapons that players want from at Beta 1.3 news
https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791459498815/announcements/detail/1678024334214732160
This is certainly not a bad check.：） 
In the next version, at least 3-4 new weapons will be added to the arsenal, so stay tuned!


[h1] 2.The Beta version of Blood feast 	[/h1]

The theme of the bloody feast will not be limited to special effects, we plan to extend it to the level of gameplay. For example, an attack on a zombie limb will cause the zombie to fall. If you have any good suggestions, please leave us a message.

[h1] 3.The Complete form of two hand weapon system 	[/h1]

  Many players are referring to the manual reload of the pump-type shotgun. We will try to add this feature, but in a more 'arcade' way, it won't fully emulate, making the operation too hard, but there will be more fun.


Good hunting！
INTOGAMES

notes.title: Beta 1.41 released！ Private room search,optimize and bug fix aim for Beta 1.4 !
notes.notes:
Hi,Dear fellows
    A week after the resounding launch of Beta 1.4, we are now launching the Beta 1.41 patch. This patch has been fixed and optimized for many aspects such as 8-person online and dual-armed systems. In this patch we focused on optimizing network speed and online room searching capabilities, and fixed bugs caused by the new features added in Beta 1.4.

[h1][b] 1.New feature：Private Search [/b][/h1]   
  We have added a room exact search function.----[h1][b][u]Private Match[/u][/b][/h1] All you need to do is enter the password of your friend's room ! The password is exactly the code when host a private room. And now the code will display above the level information in the lobby room.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/08c8d3741b148fc0464a20b15e6f4440fdc722f1.jpg[/img]

1.
Now the encrypted room will not appear in the list of [b][u]'Find a match'[/u][/b] .

If you want to join a favorite open room, then you may need to search multiple times.

3.
If join fail, try again :)

    Now, we have built ZomDay's Steam news browser in the main interface of the game. Now you can view the update news directly in the game.

a.Fix the bug that the pistol switches the rifle or the rifle to switch the pistol.							        
b.Fix pistol AP85 two hand hold bug.

[h1][b]4.Optimize：Bandwidth optimization[/b][/h1] 
a.Optimize the player's head and hand movements to synchronize transmission efficiency over the network 			
b.Optimized AI generation logic	


[h1][b]5.Update：Grenade throw enhance(Distance)   [/b][/h1]                               					
Now you can throw grenade very easy！
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/266d72a9476d6b720279c08ad1faf2664e3c8c36.gif[/img]



[h1][b]6.Optimize：Optimize the dropped items [/b][/h1]    
a.Optimized the internal logic of dropped items

  Non dropped items are weapons\ammo placing in the map, or things spawn from the shop.

  b.Non dropped ammunition\experience\blood packets that exists in the scene will disappear after more than 600 seconds of inactivity

[h1][b]9.Update: Challenge map 4 Achievement       [/b][/h1]

  Now the OC device will not automatically lower the framerate after the helmet is removed, which is very beneficial for multiplayer Room owners using OC devices, which means that when the OC Room owner takes off the glasses, the multiplayer The game's network connection will not be affected.

[h1][b]11.Bug Fixed：Repairing the bug when a client to pick up or sell the weapon with attachments the attachment of the firearm is not properly destroyed. (You can see some attachments floating in air)     [/b][/h1]   

[h1][b]12.Bug Fixed：After the weapon is placed in the slot, the remaining amount of weapon ammunition will display correct now . [/b][/h1]   		

[h1][b]13.Update：Microphone default ON  [/b][/h1]   	
The microphone function in the game will now be enabled by default. If you want to turn it off, use the T key to turn it off, and press the T key one time to turn it back on.


Enjoy!

notes.title: Beta 1.21 released HotFix --- Stamina system adjust ,Achievement bug fix,Gun Proficiency adjust,etc......
notes.notes:
Hi,Everyone

[h1]This is a fast hot fix patch,may not completely cover the features you want.[/h1]

Beta 1.21 is a patch for 1.2. Aiming at some feedback and requests from our players, especially on the Stamina system.


[b][h1]1.Update:Stamina system Adjust[/h1][/b]

Now the stamina cost had been adjusted.Treat it like 'Stamina pool become larger and recover faster'.
There are some basic points about stamina system now:

[u][b]a.The faster you move(locomotion Speed),the faster the stamina cost will be.[/b][/u]

[u][b]b.When you hit the enemy ,stamina energy will be recovered ,critical hit gains more.[/b][/u]

[u][b]c.Stamina ring is made up of three parts.The Green,The Yellow,The Red.(You can see the color changes)In the Green part stamina recover fastest.[/b][/u]

[u][b]d.Teleportation costs less energy now.[/b][/u]

The system will affect this game deeply in many ways especially when the 
Character class system and 4 players mode comes out.There also will be some special attack from enemy which will effect your movement.All this thing will make the game become more challenging and fun.


[b][h1]2.Bug Fixed: New Achievement unlock[/h1][/b]

New achievement should be achieved normally after this patch.


[b][h1]3.Update: Gun Proficiency adjust[/h1][/b]

Now you can level up your gun more easily


[b][h1]4.Update: Machine gun [/h1][/b]


a.Machine gun back up ammo capacity becomes higher(540 to 700)

b.Machine gun ammo box drop rate becomes higher



Enjoy!
INTOGAMES

notes.title: Beta1.071 Released HotFix --- Oculus snap turning (Right joystick button -- Only In single player or Being a Hoster )
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone

[h1]This is a fast hot fix patch,may not complete cover the features you want.[/h1]

We have received a lot of feedback since patch 1.07 released.Most of these feedback are talking about OC [u]snap turning[/u] and [u]trackpad locomotion[/u].We can see players really need this two features.So, in this patch we add snap turning as fast as we can and some other cool things.

Here is the change list:
 
[h1][b]1.New Feature: Oculus snap turning (Only for OC currently )[/b][/h1]

Now if you use OC you can push the --- Right hand joystick button --- down to trigger the snap turning.This will make you turn 180° so you don't have to turn around and lose your signal.

[u]!!Attention!! --Currently this feature only works in single player or being a Hoster in multiplayer game.If you join in a game don't use it or you will not be able to hit enemy.If this happens press the button again it will turn to normal.We will fix it in the next few hours.Sorry for this. [/u]

[h1][b]2.Update:Spawn extra weapons for the post login[/b][/h1]

A player told us that his friend joined in his game in half and he don't have any weapons to use.
Now when a new player join in the game, extra weapon and ammo will be spawned on the weapon table.

[h1][b]3.Update: Explosible enemy VFX[/b][/h1]

See what will happen when a screamer or boomer explode ːMMExplotionː

[h1][b]4.Update: Big Coin VFX[/b][/h1]

Now the big coin looks cooler. Remember to hit it as hard as you can !


PS:
As for the trackpad locomotion we really want to hear your advice.Please tell use what kinds of trackpad locomotion is the most comfortable way. Or you can just name some games that satisfy you most.
More things are coming!

Have fun!
Team INTOGAMES



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/597df4e62641906d73c8c1fdd7a58e924524e110.jpg[/img]
